scope: All 40 previously unaudited entries in nine wireless/receiver/controller/tool families. This is a complete per-ID eligibility review; pending statuses explicitly retain unresolved physical assemblies rather than certifying them.
policy: Manufacturer package/contact evidence is independent of reference native carrier geometry. A source URL or 2.54 mm label alone does not opt a part into insertion.
Genuine SMT, card-edge, cable and dense-header interfaces remain distinct from unresolved installed-post assemblies. A 2.54 mm segment pitch is never reported as itself incompatible.
All published IDs, pin anchors, default SVGs and native exports remain unchanged. No automatic insertion profile is registered by this audit.
The manufacturer-supplied SuperD four-pin header, Nordic castellated grid and flight-controller loose headers are explicitly kept as source/assembly candidates.

A 2.54 mm segment pitch does not establish the complete row phase, installed-post separation or underside assembly. This exact raw RF package needs a source-reviewed carrier; it is not classified as incompatible solely because of its within-group pitch.

entries.name: BETAFPV SuperD 2.4 GHz ExpressLRS Receiver
entries.revision: 2.4 GHz SuperD / User Manual edition II, 2023-05-25
entries.package: 22 × 14 mm diversity receiver with four plated wire/header contacts
entries.reason: The manufacturer supplies a four-pin header and a four-wire harness, so this is a legitimate direct-insertion candidate rather than a proven incompatible receiver. Product diagrams and the 16-page edition-II manual confirm the complete RX/TX/5V/GND order and board dimensions. They do not numerically dimension the header centers, first-post offset or exact pitch; no matched board CAD was found. The approximate 2.54 mm carrier and a supplied generic four-pin strip are insufficient to certify the installed post map.

entries.name: RadioMaster ER4 ExpressLRS PWM Receiver
entries.revision: ER4 / manufacturer user card and factory product
entries.package: Keyed side-facing 2 × 6 servo contact field, 2.54 mm pitch
entries.reason: The manufacturer confirms 2.54 mm contacts, but the ER4 mating face is a complete two-column six-position servo connector, not two long breadboard strips. CH1 and CH2 occupy an adjacent pair; so do CH3 and CH4 at the opposite end. Both contacts of each adjacent pair would join one breadboard conductor, while a quarter turn would join PWM, servo supply and ground down a column. The full connector cannot straddle the breadboard trench at its 2.54 mm inter-column gap. Factory posts face sideways, and EXT-V is a separate rear wire pad. Use cables or a receiver adapter; do not omit servo channels to force fitting.

evidence.label: Manufacturer confirms 2.54 mm connector and factory assembly

entries.name: SpeedyBee F405 WING MINI
entries.package: Multi-board flight controller / servo and cable interfaces
entries.reason: The SpeedyBee F405 WING MINI manual distinguishes the flight/power boards, angled servo banks, cable sockets and rear solder alternatives. Some supplied strips use ordinary header contacts, but that does not establish a single complete downward installation. A correct physical view must retain all 105 published contacts, include the actual lower-board and connector clearances, and locate complete selected banks without shorting adjacent servo/supply nets. The published stack envelope and off-board wiring carrier do not provide the complete numerical post/phase map. Keep this as a specific assembly-map candidate, not a rejection of all 2.54 mm parts.

entries.name: Matek F405-WING-V2
entries.package: Multi-board flight controller / servo and cable interfaces
entries.reason: Matek explicitly supplies 2.54 mm Dupont pins with this unsoldered V2 board, so the pitch itself is not a compatibility exclusion. Its servo strips, independent UART/power banks, side cable socket and numerous underside solder contacts need a complete per-revision physical view. The source identifies 54 × 36 × 13 mm overall dimensions and 30.5 mm mounting centers, but not exact first-post offsets or all inter-bank phases. Dense fully populated servo banks would share independent supply/signal contacts on breadboard strips. A header-only installation could be reviewed after exact CAD/assembly and all 87 endpoint projections are resolved; the current off-board carrier cannot establish it.

evidence.label: Manufacturer V2 pin package and 54 × 36 × 13 mm assembly

entries.name: Matek M10Q-5883 GNSS and Compass
entries.package: JST GH six-contact cable sockets and two underside service pads
entries.reason: The exact M10Q-5883 manufacturer page identifies SM06B-GHS-TB and the supplied JST-GH six-wire cable. JST specifies the GH series at 1.25 mm pitch; the Matek page says 1.27 mm, which is a source typo rather than 2.54 mm assembly evidence. Both fitted sockets repeat the same six signals; the two service pads remain separate wiring contacts. There is no downward male-header bank on this cable-connected module.

entries.name: Nordic nRF52840 Dongle
entries.package: Castellated USB dongle / rear service pads
entries.reason: Nordic explicitly specifies a 2.54 mm castellated grid with 15.24 mm row separation and describes stripboard connection. The two SWD edge sites use a different 10.16 mm row separation; all nine additional GPIO points, RESET and USB service pads are on the underside. The v2.1.1 production archive confirms an edge-castellated assembly rather than a reviewed installed downward header. Directly soldering an arbitrary strip to half-holes is not yet a qualified assembly map. Retain this as an installed-post/clearance evidence gap, not a claim that the GPIO pitch is incompatible; a carrier or documented complete header installation can resolve it.

entries.name: Nordic Power Profiler Kit II
entries.package: Two 2.54 mm right-angle SMT lists plus 1.27 mm SMT debug
entries.reason: Exact Nordic pick-and-place production data identifies P1 as LIST_ANG_1x4-SMD-2.54MM, P2 as LIST_ANG_1x10-SMD-2.54MM, and P3 as HDR_2x5-SMD-1.27mm-ANG. P1/P2 are actual side-facing surface-mount connectors, not plated through-hole strips that can simply receive straight downward replacements. The drill files confirm no 1 mm primary-header bores. P3 is also SMT and has 1.27 mm pitch. These cable-facing connectors need a carrier or a separately sourced replacement assembly; the native 2.54 mm off-board termination footprint does not establish direct insertion.

entries.name: NXP FRDM-KL25Z (Rev E)
entries.package: Arduino UNO-compatible 64-contact double-row expansion interfaces and auxiliary headers
entries.reason: The Rev E KL25Z has four double-row Arduino-compatible expansion banks with sixty-four contacts. Within-bank 2.54 mm pitch does not turn the complete 2-row field into two breadboard-straddling strips: adjacent independent signals would share a terminal conductor, and the UNO bank layout is not one complete breadboard grid. The auxiliary debug interface is a fine-pitch keyed header. The old canonical Rev E schematic URL now returns 404; the accessible manufacturer SCH-27556 PDF is Rev D, so it is retained only as family corroboration and is not substituted for exact Rev E mechanical CAD. Use shield/debug cables or an adapter; any future auxiliary-only insertion needs its own explicit complete view.

evidence.label: Manufacturer board and Arduino header scope
